verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents hybrid (semantic+full-text) search with embedder configuration and even name-drops 'conversational interfaces' as part of its single API story, but the evidence pack contains no documented endpoint or workflow specifically for RAG/answer generation (e.g., a chat/answers API, prompt templates, or LLM-response synthesis) — only vector retrieval building blocks. Missing for 10: a documented answer/chat completion API, RAG-specific tutorial or endpoint, and independent confirmation of conversational-answer functionality beyond the one-line marketing claim.
